sentences.text: A single song can transform an hour-long commute completely.
sentences.ipa: ə ˈsɪŋɡəl sɒŋ kæn trænsˈfɔːrm ən ˈaʊər lɒŋ kəˈmjuːt kəmˈpliːtli

sentences.text: Cooking dinner feels different when good music fills the kitchen.

translation.en: Cooking dinner feels different when good music fills the kitchen.

translation.en: Writing in my journal helps me understand what I actually think.

sentences.text: Art doesn't belong only to museums; it belongs to everyone.

translation.en: Art doesn't belong only to museums; it belongs to everyone.

translation.en: Fresh-baked bread still pulls me back to childhood instantly.

translation.en: Summer afternoons felt endless when we played until dark.

translation.en: With time, even painful memories soften into something bittersweet.

translation.en: Knowing when you have enough is a decision only you can make.

sentences.text: The corridor stretched into darkness beyond the reach of my candle.
sentences.ipa: ðə kəˈrɪdər strɛtʃt ˈɪntuː ˈdɑːrknəs bɪˈɑːnd ðə riːtʃ əv maɪ ˈkændəl

translation.zh: 走廊延伸进烛光触及不到的黑暗之中。
translation.en: The corridor stretched into darkness beyond the reach of my candle.

sentences.text: At midnight I heard a sound that no wind could have made.
sentences.ipa: æt ˈmɪdnaɪt aɪ hɜːrd ə saʊnd ðæt noʊ wɪnd kʊd həv meɪd

translation.zh: 午夜时分，我听到一种任何风都不可能发出的声音。
translation.en: At midnight I heard a sound that no wind could have made.

sentences.text: The portrait on the wall seemed to follow me with its pale, still eyes.
sentences.ipa: ðə ˈpɔːrtrət ɑːn ðə wɔːl siːmd tə ˈfɑːloʊ miː wɪð ɪts peɪl stɪl aɪz

translation.zh: 墙上的肖像似乎用那双苍白而静止的眼睛追随着我。
translation.en: The portrait on the wall seemed to follow me with its pale, still eyes.

sentences.text: A raven perched on the windowsill and refused to leave through the night.
sentences.ipa: ə ˈreɪvən pɜːrtʃt ɑːn ðə ˈwɪndoʊsɪl ænd rɪˈfjuːzd tə liːv θruː ðə naɪt

translation.zh: 一只乌鸦停在窗台上，整夜都不肯离去。
translation.en: A raven perched on the windowsill and refused to leave through the night.

sentences.text: I could not tell whether I was awake or still lost in a dream.
sentences.ipa: aɪ kʊd nɑːt tɛl ˈwɛðər aɪ wəz əˈweɪk ɔːr stɪl lɔːst ɪn ə driːm

translation.zh: 我分不清自己究竟是醒着，还是仍迷失在梦中。
translation.en: I could not tell whether I was awake or still lost in a dream.

sentences.text: The old clock struck once and then fell silent, as if time itself had stopped.
sentences.ipa: ði oʊld klɑːk strʌk wʌns ænd ðɛn fɛl ˈsaɪlənt æz ɪf taɪm ɪtˈsɛlf hæd stɑːpt

translation.zh: 那座老钟敲了一下，随即陷入沉默，仿佛时间本身也停止了。
translation.en: The old clock struck once and then fell silent, as if time itself had stopped.

sentences.text: My unease grew with every step I took deeper into the dim house.
sentences.ipa: maɪ ʌnˈiːz ɡruː wɪð ˈɛvri stɛp aɪ tʊk ˈdiːpər ˈɪntuː ðə dɪm haʊs

translation.zh: 每向那幢昏暗的房子深处走一步，我的不安便加深一分。
translation.en: My unease grew with every step I took deeper into the dim house.

sentences.text: Starting with just twenty minutes a day builds a real habit.
sentences.ipa: ˈstɑrtɪŋ wɪð dʒʌst ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ə deɪ bɪldz ə riːl ˈhæbɪt

translation.zh: 每天只用二十分钟就能养成真正的习惯。
translation.en: Starting with just twenty minutes a day builds a real habit.

sentences.ipa: bʊks bɪˈkʌm ˈkwaɪət kəmˈpænjənz ðæt ˈnɛvər dɪˈmænd ˈɛniθɪŋ frəm juː

translation.zh: 书成为安静的伴侣，从不对你有任何要求。
translation.en: Books become quiet companions that never demand anything from you.

sentences.text: Reading fiction teaches you to understand lives very different from your own.
sentences.ipa: ˈriːdɪŋ ˈfɪkʃən ˈtiːtʃɪz juː tə ˌʌndərˈstænd laɪvz ˈvɛri ˈdɪfrənt frəm jər oʊn

translation.zh: 阅读小说教会你理解与自己截然不同的生活。
translation.en: Reading fiction teaches you to understand lives very different from your own.

sentences.text: Nonfiction opens up worlds you never knew existed.
sentences.ipa: nɒnˈfɪkʃən ˈoʊpənz ʌp wɜrldz juː ˈnɛvər njuː ɪgˈzɪstɪd

translation.zh: 非虚构类作品为你开启了你从未知晓的世界。
translation.en: Nonfiction opens up worlds you never knew existed.

sentences.text: Finishing a long novel feels like saying goodbye to old friends.
sentences.ipa: ˈfɪnɪʃɪŋ ə lɔŋ ˈnɒvəl fiːlz laɪk ˈseɪɪŋ ɡʊdˈbaɪ tə oʊld frɛndz

translation.zh: 读完一部长篇小说就像向老朋友道别。
translation.en: Finishing a long novel feels like saying goodbye to old friends.

sentences.text: Passing a favorite book to a friend is a gift of trust.
sentences.ipa: ˈpæsɪŋ ə ˈfeɪvərɪt bʊk tə ə frɛnd ɪz ə ɡɪft əv trʌst

translation.zh: 把自己最爱的书送给朋友是一份信任的礼物。
translation.en: Passing a favorite book to a friend is a gift of trust.

sentences.text: Over years, a personal library becomes a map of who you are.
sentences.ipa: ˈoʊvər jɪrz ə ˈpɜrsənəl ˈlaɪbrɛri bɪˈkʌmz ə mæp əv huː juː ɑr

translation.zh: 多年来，私人藏书逐渐成为记录你是谁的地图。
translation.en: Over years, a personal library becomes a map of who you are.

sentences.text: A soldier walked home and met an old witch on the road.
sentences.ipa: ə ˈsoʊldʒər wɔkt hoʊm ænd mɛt ən oʊld wɪtʃ ɑn ðə roʊd

translation.zh: 一个士兵走在回家路上，遇见了一位老女巫。
translation.en: A soldier walked home and met an old witch on the road.

sentences.text: The witch sent him into a hollow tree to fetch a magic box.
sentences.ipa: ðə wɪtʃ sɛnt hɪm ˈɪntə ə ˈhɑloʊ tri tə fɛtʃ ə ˈmædʒɪk bɑks

translation.zh: 女巫让他钻进一棵空心树，去取一个魔法盒子。
translation.en: The witch sent him into a hollow tree to fetch a magic box.

sentences.text: Inside he found three rooms, each guarded by a giant dog.
sentences.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd hi faʊnd θri rumz itʃ ˈɡɑrdɪd baɪ ə ˈdʒaɪənt dɔɡ

translation.zh: 在里面，他发现了三个房间，每间都有一只巨犬守卫。
translation.en: Inside he found three rooms, each guarded by a giant dog.

sentences.text: The dogs sat on chests filled with copper, silver, and gold.
sentences.ipa: ðə dɔɡz sæt ɑn tʃɛsts fɪld wɪð ˈkɑpər ˈsɪlvər ænd ɡoʊld

translation.zh: 这些狗坐在装满铜、银和金子的宝箱上。
translation.en: The dogs sat on chests filled with copper, silver, and gold.

sentences.text: He took the treasure and the tinder-box, then refused the witch's demands.
sentences.ipa: hi tʊk ðə ˈtrɛʒər ænd ðə ˈtɪndər bɑks ðɛn rɪˈfjuzd ðə ˈwɪtʃɪz dɪˈmændz

translation.zh: 他拿走了宝藏和火匣，然后拒绝了女巫的要求。
translation.en: He took the treasure and the tinder-box, then refused the witch's demands.

sentences.text: He soon discovered that striking the box would summon the three dogs.
sentences.ipa: hi sun dɪˈskʌvərd ðæt ˈstraɪkɪŋ ðə bɑks wʊd ˈsʌmən ðə θri dɔɡz

translation.zh: 他很快发现，敲击火匣就能召唤出那三只狗。
translation.en: He soon discovered that striking the box would summon the three dogs.

sentences.text: With the dogs' power, the soldier won the princess and became king.
sentences.ipa: wɪð ðə dɔɡz ˈpaʊər ðə ˈsoʊldʒər wʌn ðə ˈprɪnsɛs ænd bɪˈkeɪm kɪŋ

translation.zh: 凭借狗的力量，士兵赢得了公主，并成为了国王。
translation.en: With the dogs' power, the soldier won the princess and became king.

sentences.text: Some traditions have been passed down for hundreds of years.

translation.en: Some traditions have been passed down for hundreds of years.

sentences.text: My grandmother's dumplings taste like home and childhood.
sentences.ipa: maɪ ˈɡrænˌmʌðərz ˈdʌmplɪŋz teɪst laɪk hoʊm ænd ˈtʃaɪldhʊd

translation.zh: 奶奶的饺子尝起来像家和童年的味道。
translation.en: My grandmother's dumplings taste like home and childhood.

sentences.text: Holidays bring scattered family members back under one roof.
sentences.ipa: ˈhɑlɪdeɪz brɪŋ ˈskætərd ˈfæmɪli ˈmɛmbərz bæk ˈʌndər wʌn ruf

translation.zh: 节日让散落各地的家人重聚在同一屋檐下。
translation.en: Holidays bring scattered family members back under one roof.

sentences.text: Language carries the stories and values of a whole people.
sentences.ipa: ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˈkæriz ðə ˈstɔriz ænd ˈvæljuz əv ə hoʊl ˈpipəl

translation.zh: 语言承载着一个民族的故事与价值观。
translation.en: Language carries the stories and values of a whole people.

sentences.text: Modern life makes it harder to keep old customs alive.
sentences.ipa: ˈmɑdərn laɪf meɪks ɪt ˈhɑrdər tə kip oʊld ˈkʌstəmz əˈlaɪv

translation.zh: 现代生活让保留旧习俗变得更加困难。
translation.en: Modern life makes it harder to keep old customs alive.

sentences.text: Marrying into another culture means blending two sets of traditions.
sentences.ipa: ˈmæriɪŋ ˈɪntə əˈnʌðər ˈkʌltʃər mɪnz ˈblɛndɪŋ tu sɛts əv trəˈdɪʃənz

translation.zh: 嫁入另一种文化意味着融合两套传统。
translation.en: Marrying into another culture means blending two sets of traditions.

sentences.text: We choose which traditions to honor and which to leave behind.

translation.zh: 我们选择哪些传统值得传承，哪些可以放下。
translation.en: We choose which traditions to honor and which to leave behind.

sentences.text: I volunteer because I need to feel part of something larger.
sentences.ipa: aɪ ˈvɒlənˌtɪr bɪˈkɔːz aɪ niːd tə fiːl pɑːrt əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈlɑːrdʒər

translation.zh: 我做志愿者，是因为我需要感觉自己是更大事业的一部分。
translation.en: I volunteer because I need to feel part of something larger.

sentences.text: Choosing a cause is finding where your anger meets your hope.
sentences.ipa: ˈtʃuːzɪŋ ə kɔːz ɪz ˈfaɪndɪŋ wɛr jʊr ˈæŋɡər miːts jʊr hoʊp

translation.en: Choosing a cause is finding where your anger meets your hope.

sentences.ipa: aɪ ɡɑːrd ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋz fər ˈsɜːrvɪs ænd stɪl ɡɛt ˈɛvriθɪŋ dʌn

translation.zh: 我把每个周六上午留给志愿服务，其他事情依然完成得很好。
translation.en: I guard Saturday mornings for service and still get everything done.

sentences.text: Small actions accumulate until the neighborhood looks visibly different.
sentences.ipa: smɔːl ˈækʃənz əˈkjuːmjʊleɪt ənˈtɪl ðə ˈneɪbərˌhʊd lʊks ˈvɪzɪbli ˈdɪfrənt

translation.en: Small actions accumulate until the neighborhood looks visibly different.

sentences.text: The people I serve teach me patience I never expected to learn.
sentences.ipa: ðə ˈpiːpəl aɪ sɜːrv tiːtʃ miː ˈpeɪʃəns aɪ ˈnɛvər ɪkˈspɛktɪd tə lɜːrn

translation.zh: 我服务的人们教会我一种我从未料到能学到的耐心。
translation.en: The people I serve teach me patience I never expected to learn.

sentences.text: We bonded over shared work in ways that friendship rarely allows.
sentences.ipa: wiː ˈbɒndɪd ˈoʊvər ʃɛrd wɜːrk ɪn weɪz ðæt ˈfrɛndʃɪp ˈrɛrli əˈlaʊz

translation.zh: 我们在共同劳动中建立了友谊，这是平常的友谊很难做到的。
translation.en: We bonded over shared work in ways that friendship rarely allows.

translation.zh: 哪怕只是一个行动也很重要，因为那一端的人是真实存在的。

translation.en: The open road stretches wide before us, calling every restless soul onward.

translation.en: Workers rise at dawn, their strong hands ready to shape the living world.

sentences.text: Ships crowd the harbor, their flags bright against the morning sky.

translation.en: Ships crowd the harbor, their flags bright against the morning sky.

sentences.text: Children laugh in the streets, and their joy belongs to the whole nation.
sentences.ipa: ˈtʃɪldrən læf ɪn ðə striːts ænd ðɛr dʒɔɪ bɪˈlɔŋz tə ðə hoʊl ˈneɪʃən

translation.zh: 孩子们在街头欢笑，他们的喜悦属于整个国家。
translation.en: Children laugh in the streets, and their joy belongs to the whole nation.

sentences.text: Every common worker carries within them the full dignity of this land.
sentences.ipa: ˈɛvri ˈkɑːmən ˈwɜːrkər ˈkæriz wɪˈðɪn ðɛm ðə fʊl ˈdɪɡnɪti əv ðɪs lænd

translation.en: Every common worker carries within them the full dignity of this land.

sentences.ipa: aɪ hɪr ðə ɡreɪt ˈkʌntri ˈbriːðɪŋ væst ænd əˈlaɪv frəm ʃɔːr tə ʃɔːr

sentences.text: A fox invited a stork to dinner.
sentences.ipa: ə fɑks ɪnˈvaɪtɪd ə stɔrk tə ˈdɪnər

translation.en: A fox invited a stork to dinner.

sentences.text: He served soup on a flat plate.
sentences.ipa: hi sɜrvd sup ɑn ə flæt pleɪt

translation.zh: 他把汤盛在一个平盘子里。
translation.en: He served soup on a flat plate.

sentences.text: The stork could not eat from the plate.
sentences.ipa: ðə stɔrk kʊd nɑt it frəm ðə pleɪt

translation.zh: 鹳没法从盘子里吃东西。
translation.en: The stork could not eat from the plate.

sentences.text: The stork served food in a tall jar.
sentences.ipa: ðə stɔrk sɜrvd fud ɪn ə tɔl dʒɑr

translation.zh: 鹳把食物盛在一个高罐子里。
translation.en: The stork served food in a tall jar.

sentences.text: Now the fox learned to treat others fairly.
sentences.ipa: naʊ ðə fɑks lɜrnd tə trit ˈʌðərz ˈfɛrli

translation.zh: 这下狐狸学会了公平待人。
translation.en: Now the fox learned to treat others fairly.

sentences.text: I take the bus to my friend's house.
sentences.ipa: aɪ teɪk ðə bʌs tə maɪ frɛndz haʊs

translation.en: I take the bus to my friend's house.

sentences.text: I bring some flowers and a small gift.
sentences.ipa: aɪ brɪŋ sʌm ˈflaʊərz ænd ə smɔːl ɡɪft

translation.en: I bring some flowers and a small gift.

sentences.text: We drink tea and talk for hours.
sentences.ipa: wiː drɪŋk tiː ænd tɔːk fər ˈaʊərz

translation.zh: 我们喝茶聊了好几个小时。
translation.en: We drink tea and talk for hours.

sentences.text: Her cat sleeps on the sofa next to us.
sentences.ipa: hɜːr kæt sliːps ɒn ðə ˈsoʊfə nɛkst tə ʌs

translation.zh: 她的猫睡在沙发上紧挨着我们。
translation.en: Her cat sleeps on the sofa next to us.

sentences.text: I leave when the sun goes down.
sentences.ipa: aɪ liːv wɛn ðə sʌn ɡoʊz daʊn

translation.en: I leave when the sun goes down.

sentences.text: I'd like to schedule an appointment with the doctor.
sentences.ipa: aɪd laɪk tə ˈskɛdʒuːl ən əˈpɔɪntmənt wɪð ðə ˈdɒktər

translation.en: I'd like to schedule an appointment with the doctor.

sentences.text: She arrived at the clinic right on time.
sentences.ipa: ʃi əˈraɪvd æt ðə ˈklɪnɪk raɪt ɒn taɪm

translation.en: She arrived at the clinic right on time.

sentences.text: My name is Chen. I have a ten o'clock appointment.
sentences.ipa: maɪ neɪm ɪz tʃɛn aɪ hæv ə tɛn əˈklɒk əˈpɔɪntmənt

translation.zh: 我叫陈。我有个十点的预约。
translation.en: My name is Chen. I have a ten o'clock appointment.

tokens.text: I have a ten o'clock appointment
tokens.ipa: aɪ hæv ə tɛn əˈklɒk əˈpɔɪntmənt

translation.en: I have a ten o'clock appointment

sentences.text: The nurse checks your blood pressure before the exam.
sentences.ipa: ðə nɜːrs tʃɛks jɔːr blʌd ˈprɛʃər bɪˈfɔːr ðə ɪɡˈzæm

translation.zh: 护士在检查前量你的血压。
translation.en: The nurse checks your blood pressure before the exam.

sentences.text: Do you exercise regularly and get enough sleep?
sentences.ipa: duː juː ˈɛksərsaɪz ˈrɛɡjələrli ænd ɡɛt ɪˈnʌf sliːp

translation.zh: 你定期锻炼吗？睡眠充足吗？
translation.en: Do you exercise regularly and get enough sleep?

sentences.text: He left the office with a prescription in hand.
sentences.ipa: hi lɛft ði ˈɒfɪs wɪð ə prɪˈskrɪpʃən ɪn hænd

translation.zh: 他手里拿着处方离开了诊室。
translation.en: He left the office with a prescription in hand.

sentences.text: An old donkey ran away to become a musician.
sentences.ipa: æn oʊld ˈdɑŋki ræn əˈweɪ tə bɪˈkʌm ə mjuˈzɪʃən

translation.zh: 一头老驴逃跑去当音乐家。
translation.en: An old donkey ran away to become a musician.

sentences.text: On the road he found a worn-out dog resting.
sentences.ipa: ɑn ðə roʊd hi faʊnd ə wɔrnˈaʊt dɔɡ ˈrɛstɪŋ

translation.zh: 在路上他发现一只疲惫的狗在休息。
translation.en: On the road he found a worn-out dog resting.

sentences.text: Next they met a tired cat sitting by the path.
sentences.ipa: nɛkst ðeɪ mɛt ə ˈtaɪərd kæt ˈsɪtɪŋ baɪ ðə pæθ

translation.zh: 接着他们遇到一只坐在路边的累猫。
translation.en: Next they met a tired cat sitting by the path.

sentences.text: They also met a rooster about to be cooked.
sentences.ipa: ðeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ mɛt ə ˈrustər əˈbaʊt tə bi kʊkt

translation.zh: 他们还遇到一只即将被宰的公鸡。
translation.en: They also met a rooster about to be cooked.

sentences.text: The four animals stood on each other and scared the robbers away.
sentences.ipa: ðə fɔr ˈænɪməlz stʊd ɑn itʃ ˈʌðər ænd skɛrd ðə ˈrɑbərz əˈweɪ

translation.zh: 四只动物叠在一起，把强盗吓跑了。
translation.en: The four animals stood on each other and scared the robbers away.

sentences.text: They stayed in the house and lived happily together.
sentences.ipa: ðeɪ steɪd ɪn ðə haʊs ænd lɪvd ˈhæpɪli təˈɡɛðər

translation.zh: 他们留在屋子里，幸福地生活在一起。
translation.en: They stayed in the house and lived happily together.

sentences.text: I see a posting for a marketing role.
sentences.ipa: aɪ siː ə ˈpoʊstɪŋ fər ə ˈmɑːrkɪtɪŋ roʊl

translation.zh: 我看到一个市场职位的招聘。
translation.en: I see a posting for a marketing role.

sentences.text: I update my resume and cover letter.
sentences.ipa: aɪ ʌpˈdeɪt maɪ ˈrɛzəˌmeɪ ænd ˈkʌvər ˈlɛtər

translation.en: I update my resume and cover letter.

sentences.text: I apply through the company website.
sentences.ipa: aɪ əˈplaɪ θruː ðə ˈkʌmpəni ˈwɛbˌsaɪt

translation.en: I apply through the company website.

sentences.text: I get an email two days later.
sentences.ipa: aɪ ɡɛt ən ˈiːmeɪl tuː deɪz ˈleɪtər

translation.zh: 两天后我收到一封邮件。
translation.en: I get an email two days later.

sentences.text: They invite me for a phone interview.
sentences.ipa: ðeɪ ɪnˈvaɪt miː fər ə foʊn ˈɪntərvjuː

translation.zh: 他们邀请我参加电话面试。
translation.en: They invite me for a phone interview.

sentences.text: I prepare answers to common questions.
sentences.ipa: aɪ prɪˈpɛr ˈænsərz tuː ˈkɒmən ˈkwɛstʃənz

translation.zh: 我准备常见问题的答案。
translation.en: I prepare answers to common questions.

sentences.text: I packed my things into many cardboard boxes.
sentences.ipa: aɪ pækt maɪ θɪŋz ˈɪntuː ˈmɛni ˈkɑːrdbɔːrd ˈbɒksɪz

translation.zh: 我把东西装进了很多纸板箱。
translation.en: I packed my things into many cardboard boxes.

sentences.text: The moving truck arrived early on Saturday morning.
sentences.ipa: ðə ˈmuːvɪŋ trʌk əˈraɪvd ˈɜːrli ɒn ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ

translation.zh: 搬家卡车周六早上提早到了。
translation.en: The moving truck arrived early on Saturday morning.

sentences.text: The new apartment felt empty at first.
sentences.ipa: ðə njuː əˈpɑːrtmənt fɛlt ˈɛmpti æt fɜːrst

translation.zh: 新公寓起初感觉很空旷。
translation.en: The new apartment felt empty at first.

sentences.text: I explored the neighborhood and found a coffee shop.
sentences.ipa: aɪ ɪkˈsplɔːrd ðə ˈneɪbərhʊd ænd faʊnd ə ˈkɒfi ʃɒp

translation.zh: 我探索了附近，发现了一家咖啡店。
translation.en: I explored the neighborhood and found a coffee shop.

sentences.text: Making new friends took a few weeks of effort.
sentences.ipa: ˈmeɪkɪŋ njuː frɛndz tʊk ə fjuː wiːks əv ˈɛfərt

translation.zh: 交到新朋友花了几周的努力。
translation.en: Making new friends took a few weeks of effort.

sentences.text: The city slowly began to feel like home.
sentences.ipa: ðə ˈsɪti ˈsloʊli bɪˈɡæn tuː fiːl laɪk hoʊm

translation.zh: 这座城市慢慢开始有了家的感觉。
translation.en: The city slowly began to feel like home.

sentences.text: A prince searched the world for a true princess.
sentences.ipa: ə prɪns sɜrtʃt ðə wɜrld fər ə tru ˈprɪnsɛs

translation.zh: 一位王子走遍世界寻找真正的公主。
translation.en: A prince searched the world for a true princess.

sentences.text: On a stormy night, a wet girl knocked on the door.
sentences.ipa: ɑn ə ˈstɔrmi naɪt ə wɛt ɡɜrl nɑkt ɑn ðə dɔr

translation.zh: 在一个暴风雨之夜，一个浑身湿透的女孩敲了门。
translation.en: On a stormy night, a wet girl knocked on the door.

sentences.text: She claimed to be a real princess.
sentences.ipa: ʃi kleɪmd tə bi ə riəl ˈprɪnsɛs

translation.zh: 她声称自己是一位真正的公主。
translation.en: She claimed to be a real princess.

sentences.text: The queen hid a pea under twenty mattresses to test her.
sentences.ipa: ðə kwin hɪd ə pi ˈʌndər ˈtwɛnti ˈmætrɪsɪz tə tɛst hər

translation.zh: 王后把一粒豌豆藏在二十层床垫下面来测试她。
translation.en: The queen hid a pea under twenty mattresses to test her.

sentences.text: In the morning she said she could not sleep at all.
sentences.ipa: ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ʃi sɛd ʃi kʊd nɑt slip æt ɔl

translation.zh: 早上她说她根本无法入睡。
translation.en: In the morning she said she could not sleep at all.

sentences.text: The prince married her because only a true princess could feel the pea.
sentences.ipa: ðə prɪns ˈmærid hər bɪˈkɔz ˈoʊnli ə tru ˈprɪnsɛs kʊd fil ðə pi

translation.zh: 王子娶了她，因为只有真正的公主才能感觉到那粒豌豆。
translation.en: The prince married her because only a true princess could feel the pea.

sentences.text: A pros and cons list rarely settles the hardest choices.
sentences.ipa: ə proʊz ænd kɒnz lɪst ˈrɛrli ˈsɛtlz ðə ˈhɑːrdɪst ˈtʃɔɪsɪz

translation.zh: 利弊清单很少能真正解决最难的抉择。
translation.en: A pros and cons list rarely settles the hardest choices.

sentences.text: After all the analysis, I learned to trust what my gut said.
sentences.ipa: ˈæftər ɔːl ðɪ əˈnæləsɪs aɪ lɜːrnd tə trʌst wɒt maɪ ɡʌt sɛd

translation.zh: 做完所有分析之后，我学会了相信直觉的判断。
translation.en: After all the analysis, I learned to trust what my gut said.

sentences.text: Fear of missing out is a terrible advisor when facing big decisions.
sentences.ipa: fɪr əv ˈmɪsɪŋ aʊt ɪz ə ˈtɛrɪbl ədˈvaɪzər wɛn ˈfeɪsɪŋ bɪɡ dɪˈsɪʒənz

translation.zh: 面对重大决定时，错失恐惧是个糟糕的参谋。
translation.en: Fear of missing out is a terrible advisor when facing big decisions.

sentences.text: Talking it through with a wise friend often brings unexpected clarity.
sentences.ipa: ˈtɔːkɪŋ ɪt θruː wɪð ə waɪz frɛnd ˈɔːfən brɪŋz ˌʌnɪkˈspɛktɪd ˈklærɪti

translation.zh: 与睿智的朋友倾谈，往往能带来意想不到的清晰感。
translation.en: Talking it through with a wise friend often brings unexpected clarity.

sentences.text: I've learned to sleep on it before committing to any major change.
sentences.ipa: aɪv lɜːrnd tə sliːp ɒn ɪt bɪˈfɔːr kəˈmɪtɪŋ tə ˈɛni ˈmeɪdʒər tʃeɪndʒ

translation.zh: 我学会了在做出重大改变之前，先睡一觉再说。
translation.en: I've learned to sleep on it before committing to any major change.

tokens.text: I've learned to sleep on it
tokens.ipa: aɪv lɜːrnd tə sliːp ɒn ɪt

translation.zh: 我学会了搁置一晚再想

sentences.text: Every path carries some risk; the goal is choosing wisely, not safely.
sentences.ipa: ˈɛvri pæθ ˈkæriz sʌm rɪsk ðə ɡoʊl ɪz ˈtʃuːzɪŋ ˈwaɪzli nɒt ˈseɪfli

translation.zh: 每条路都有风险；目标是明智地选择，而非安全地回避。
translation.en: Every path carries some risk; the goal is choosing wisely, not safely.

sentences.text: Once you decide, own the outcome — blame shifts nothing forward.
sentences.ipa: wʌns juː dɪˈsaɪd oʊn ðɪ ˈaʊtkʌm bleɪm ʃɪfts ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈfɔːrwərd

translation.zh: 一旦做出决定，就要承担结果——抱怨什么都改变不了。
translation.en: Once you decide, own the outcome — blame shifts nothing forward.

sentences.text: The first months abroad feel like one long, exciting vacation.
sentences.ipa: ðə fɜrst mʌnθs əˈbrɔd fil laɪk wʌn lɔŋ ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ vəˈkeɪʃən

translation.zh: 刚到海外的头几个月感觉像一场漫长的兴奋假期。
translation.en: The first months abroad feel like one long, exciting vacation.

sentences.text: Small daily friction slowly erodes the romance of living abroad.
sentences.ipa: smɔl ˈdeɪli ˈfrɪkʃən ˈsloʊli ɪˈroʊdz ðə ˈromæns əv ˈlɪvɪŋ əˈbrɔd

translation.zh: 日常生活中的小摩擦慢慢磨蚀了异乡生活的浪漫感。
translation.en: Small daily friction slowly erodes the romance of living abroad.

sentences.text: Your language shapes who you connect with and who stays distant.
sentences.ipa: jɔr ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ʃeɪps hu ju kəˈnɛkt wɪð ænd hu steɪz ˈdɪstənt

translation.zh: 你的语言决定了你能与谁建立联系，谁对你保持距离。
translation.en: Your language shapes who you connect with and who stays distant.

sentences.text: Holidays back home become sweeter and sadder at the same time.
sentences.ipa: ˈhɑlədeɪz bæk hoʊm bɪˈkʌm ˈswitər ænd ˈsædər æt ðə seɪm taɪm

translation.zh: 回家过节变得既甜蜜又苦涩，两种情绪同时涌现。
translation.en: Holidays back home become sweeter and sadder at the same time.

sentences.text: You stop comparing your two worlds and simply live in each.
sentences.ipa: ju stɑp kəmˈpɛrɪŋ jɔr tu wɜrldz ænd ˈsɪmpli lɪv ɪn itʃ

translation.zh: 你不再比较两个世界，只是简单地活在各自之中。
translation.en: You stop comparing your two worlds and simply live in each.

sentences.text: Your identity quietly shifts to fit the place that adopted you.
sentences.ipa: jɔr aɪˈdɛntɪti ˈkwaɪətli ʃɪfts tə fɪt ðə pleɪs ðæt əˈdɑptɪd ju

translation.zh: 你的身份认同悄然转变，慢慢融入接纳了你的地方。
translation.en: Your identity quietly shifts to fit the place that adopted you.

sentences.text: You keep the language but lose the instinct for old customs.
sentences.ipa: ju kip ðə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ bʌt luz ðə ˈɪnstɪŋkt fɔr oʊld ˈkʌstəmz

translation.zh: 你保留了语言，却渐渐失去了对旧习俗的直觉感。
translation.en: You keep the language but lose the instinct for old customs.

sentences.text: Each spring the two neighbors walk the old stone wall.
sentences.ipa: iːtʃ sprɪŋ ðə tuː ˈneɪbərz wɔːk ði oʊld stoʊn wɔːl

translation.zh: 每到春天，两位邻居沿着古老的石墙走。
translation.en: Each spring the two neighbors walk the old stone wall.

sentences.text: Winter always loosens the stones and leaves gaps in the wall.
sentences.ipa: ˈwɪntər ˈɔːlweɪz ˈluːsənz ðə stoʊnz ænd liːvz ɡæps ɪn ðə wɔːl

translation.zh: 冬天总是把石块松动，在墙上留下缺口。
translation.en: Winter always loosens the stones and leaves gaps in the wall.

sentences.text: They lift each fallen stone and balance it back in place.
sentences.ipa: ðeɪ lɪft iːtʃ ˈfɔːlən stoʊn ænd ˈbæləns ɪt bæk ɪn pleɪs

translation.zh: 他们捡起每块落石，把它平稳地放回原处。
translation.en: They lift each fallen stone and balance it back in place.

sentences.text: One man wonders aloud whether the wall is really needed at all.
sentences.ipa: wʌn mæn ˈwʌndərz əˈlaʊd ˈwɛðər ðə wɔːl ɪz ˈrɪəli ˈniːdɪd æt ɔːl

translation.zh: 一个人大声疑惑，这堵墙是否真的有必要存在。
translation.en: One man wonders aloud whether the wall is really needed at all.

sentences.text: His neighbor only repeats that good fences make good neighbors.
sentences.ipa: hɪz ˈneɪbər ˈoʊnli rɪˈpiːts ðæt ɡʊd ˈfɛnsɪz meɪk ɡʊd ˈneɪbərz

translation.zh: 他的邻居只是重复说，好篱笆造就好邻居。
translation.en: His neighbor only repeats that good fences make good neighbors.

sentences.text: The pine trees on one side need no wall to know their ground.
sentences.ipa: ðə paɪn triːz ɒn wʌn saɪd niːd noʊ wɔːl tə noʊ ðɛr ɡraʊnd

translation.zh: 一侧的松树不需要围墙，就能知道自己的领地。
translation.en: The pine trees on one side need no wall to know their ground.

sentences.text: Yet every year they meet again and mend what winter broke apart.
sentences.ipa: jɛt ˈɛvri jɪr ðeɪ miːt əˈɡɛn ænd mɛnd wɒt ˈwɪntər broʊk əˈpɑːrt

translation.zh: 然而每年他们再度相聚，修补冬天破坏的一切。
translation.en: Yet every year they meet again and mend what winter broke apart.

sentences.text: Quick results often hide the price you pay later.
sentences.ipa: kwɪk rɪˈzʌlts ˈɔːfən haɪd ðə praɪs ju peɪ ˈleɪtər

translation.zh: 快速的结果往往掩盖了你日后付出的代价。
translation.en: Quick results often hide the price you pay later.

sentences.text: The long game demands trust in work whose reward is invisible.
sentences.ipa: ðə lɔːŋ ɡeɪm dɪˈmændz trʌst ɪn wɜːrk huːz rɪˈwɔːrd ɪz ɪnˈvɪzɪbəl

translation.zh: 长远的追求需要你信任那些回报还看不见的努力。
translation.en: The long game demands trust in work whose reward is invisible.

tokens.ipa: ɪn wɜːrk huːz rɪˈwɔːrd ɪz ɪnˈvɪzɪbəl

translation.en: in work whose reward is invisible

sentences.text: A garden teaches you to wait in ways no app ever can.
sentences.ipa: ə ˈɡɑːrdən ˈtiːtʃɪz ju tə weɪt ɪn weɪz noʊ æp ˈɛvər kæn

translation.zh: 一座花园教会你等待，这是任何应用都无法做到的。
translation.en: A garden teaches you to wait in ways no app ever can.

translation.en: a garden teaches you to wait

sentences.text: Anger loses its grip when you let it pass without feeding it.
sentences.ipa: ˈæŋɡər ˈluːzɪz ɪts ɡrɪp wɛn ju lɛt ɪt pæs wɪˈðaʊt ˈfiːdɪŋ ɪt

translation.zh: 愤怒在你不加以纵容地让它消散时，自然会失去力量。
translation.en: Anger loses its grip when you let it pass without feeding it.

sentences.text: Mastery is patience repeated quietly for years and years.
sentences.ipa: ˈmæstəri ɪz ˈpeɪʃəns rɪˈpiːtɪd ˈkwaɪətli fər jɪrz ænd jɪrz

translation.zh: 精通不过是一年又一年悄悄重复的耐心。
translation.en: Mastery is patience repeated quietly for years and years.

sentences.text: Speed feels like progress, but it often just burns your fuel.
sentences.ipa: spiːd fiːlz laɪk ˈprɑːɡrəs bʌt ɪt ˈɔːfən dʒʌst bɜːrnz jər fjuːəl

translation.zh: 速度感觉像是进步，但它往往只是在白白消耗你的精力。
translation.en: Speed feels like progress, but it often just burns your fuel.

sentences.text: Sometimes the wisest move is to sit still and do nothing.
sentences.ipa: ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ðə ˈwaɪzɪst muːv ɪz tə sɪt stɪl ænd duː ˈnʌθɪŋ

translation.zh: 有时候最明智的举动就是静下来，什么也不做。
translation.en: Sometimes the wisest move is to sit still and do nothing.

sentences.text: He praised her honesty while clearly hoping she would lie.
sentences.ipa: hiː preɪzd hɜːr ˈɑːnəsti waɪl ˈklɪrli ˈhoʊpɪŋ ʃiː wʊd laɪ

translation.zh: 他夸赞她的诚实，却显然希望她说谎。
translation.en: He praised her honesty while clearly hoping she would lie.

sentences.text: Society forgives the sinner but never forgives the one who is dull.
sentences.ipa: səˈsaɪəti fərˈɡɪvz ðə ˈsɪnər bʌt ˈnɛvər fərˈɡɪvz ðə wʌn huː ɪz dʌl

translation.zh: 社会宽恕罪人，却永远不宽恕乏味的人。
translation.en: Society forgives the sinner but never forgives the one who is dull.

sentences.text: She wore her good deeds like a hat, to be admired in public.
sentences.ipa: ʃiː wɔːr hɜːr ɡʊd diːdz laɪk ə hæt tuː biː ədˈmaɪərd ɪn ˈpʌblɪk

translation.zh: 她把善举当帽子戴，专为在公众面前博得赞赏。
translation.en: She wore her good deeds like a hat, to be admired in public.

sentences.text: A man who tells the truth about himself is usually not believed.
sentences.ipa: ə mæn huː tɛlz ðə truːθ əˈbaʊt hɪmˈsɛlf ɪz ˈjuːʒuəli nɑːt bɪˈliːvd

translation.zh: 一个对自己说实话的人，通常不会有人相信。
translation.en: A man who tells the truth about himself is usually not believed.

sentences.text: The truly modest person never stops talking about their modesty.
sentences.ipa: ðə ˈtruːli ˈmɑːdɪst ˈpɜːrsən ˈnɛvər stɑːps ˈtɔːkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðɛr ˈmɑːdɪsti

translation.zh: 真正谦逊的人从不停止谈论自己的谦逊。
translation.en: The truly modest person never stops talking about their modesty.

sentences.text: Good manners are the art of making other people feel at ease.
sentences.ipa: ɡʊd ˈmænərz ɑːr ði ɑːrt əv ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈʌðər ˈpiːpəl fiːl æt iːz

translation.zh: 好的礼仪是让别人感到自在的艺术。
translation.en: Good manners are the art of making other people feel at ease.

sentences.text: We are all capable of great things, but few of us attempt them.
sentences.ipa: wiː ɑːr ɔːl ˈkeɪpəbəl əv ɡreɪt θɪŋz bʌt fjuː əv ʌs əˈtɛmpt ðɛm

translation.zh: 我们都有能力成就伟大，却很少有人真正去尝试。
translation.en: We are all capable of great things, but few of us attempt them.
